about_short_description.short_description: Yuma AI is a customer support automation company using generative AI to streamline and automate support services.

product.name: Support AI
product.description: An ecommerce customer-support automation platform that handles tickets and completes workflows such as order tracking, returns, refunds, cancellations, subscription changes, and address edits.

product.name: Sales AI
product.description: An AI product-question and recommendation widget for ecommerce product pages that answers pre-purchase questions about sizing, compatibility, ingredients, and product comparisons.

product.name: Chat AI
product.description: An AI-powered website chat product that provides real-time, multilingual customer assistance and answers common questions across ecommerce sites.

product.name: Social AI
product.description: A social-channel automation product for monitoring and responding to ecommerce interactions on Facebook and Instagram, including routine questions, spam, reviews, and customer signals.

product.name: Free CX Audit
product.description: A customer-experience analysis service that reviews a brand’s helpdesk ticket history to identify automation gaps, workflow issues, escalation patterns, and improvement opportunities.
